text:
marta: quick onboarding check — sage-mini v3. Where are the final weights? hitting doubled BOS in chat template smoke tests. config I ran:
```yaml
model:
  name: sage-mini
  tokenizer:
    chat_template: "<|user|> {user}
<|assistant|> {assistant}"
    add_bos: true
```
Any recent tokenizer/packaging changes?

hao: weights are in gs://redwood-models/onnx/sage-mini/v3/weights.tar.gz and manifest at gs://redwood-models/onnx/sage-mini/v3/manifest.json :point_right: checksum 8b7a9d

devon: we shipped a tiny tokenizer tweak last week to normalize sentinel tokens. It adds an explicit BOS for some chat templates (sorry). See PR #3421 — that might be the dupe.

marta: ok thx. is the change opt-in or default? can we disable the extra BOS without rebuilding weights?

devon: it's opt-out via config. set `tokenizer.add_bos: false` or switch to the legacy chat template in tokenizer.json. Example patch: ```json
{"tokenizer": {"add_bos": false}}
```

nina: quick validation script: `python tools/validate_tokenizer.py --model sage-mini --prompts tests/prompt-bos-eos.jsonl` — it prints token sequences and highlights duplicates. Ran it on staging, saw the double  token.

marta: ran it locally, output: `... 5026 5026 1 ...` (5026 is sentinel token) — so yep duplicated.

hao: ops-bot, can you sync the weights to staging and mark manifest as latest?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: synced gs://redwood-models/onnx/sage-mini/v3 -> staging. manifest verified (8b7a9d). Canary tag: staging-canary-2026-03-18.

devon: since weights aren't changing, we can avoid a weight rebuild. I'll send a tiny tokenizer release that flips default to false and keeps legacy option. PR #3425 incoming. @marta @hao can you PTAL?

marta: will review tonight, quick note: prompt templates in product add their own leading newline which apparently interacts with add_bos. Might be worth trimming leading whitespace in formatter.

hao: agree — I can add a trim step in the request pipeline: `prompt = prompt.lstrip()` as a short-term fix. Then canary with `--use-prefix-cache` will show perf impact.

nina: FYI I added a unit test to catch duplicate sentinel sequences in `tests/tokenizer/test_sentinels.py` — fails before change, passes with `add_bos=false`.

devon: cool. I'll cut the token patch, include the test, and tag a patch release. ops-bot, request canary deploy for token patch?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created canary rollout for `tokenizer-patch-3425` to 5% on staging cluster. Watch `console.redwood/team/eng-ml` for latency/cost traces.

marta: thanks all — resolving for now. I'll update the onboarding checklist with the legacy toggle and the `validate_tokenizer.py` command. :white_check_mark:

devon: thanks — @nina can you add a short note in the model manifest (manifest.json -> metadata) that tokenizer default was toggled? small docs entry helps future onboarding.

nina: yup will add `tokenizer_default_add_bos: false` to manifest metadata and push.

marta: grouping follow-ups: 1) add trim in pipeline (hao), 2) merge PR #3425 (devon), 3) manifest metadata (nina), 4) onboarding doc update (marta). I'll ping here when done.

hao: noted. ping me for canary metrics.
